title: Which coordinate frame?
description: The laser is mounted 0.2 m ahead of base_link. Find its origin in odom, including when the robot is rotated.
steps: Inspect ros2 topic echo /tf --once. The tree is odom → base_link → laser_link.
Create a Buffer and TransformListener. In a timer, request lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Report translation.x and translation.y using report_transform. The target frame is the frame in which you want the answer.
hints: Wait for transforms: catch TransformException on early callbacks.
Do not simply add 0.2 to odom x; the mounting offset rotates with the robot.
The buffer composes both edges. Here it supports latest planar transforms, not historical queries.

nl.title: In welk coördinatenstelsel?
nl.description: De laser zit 0.2 m vóór base_link. Zoek zijn oorsprong in odom, ook als de robot gedraaid is.
steps: Inspecteer /tf en de TF-boom.
Maak een Buffer en TransformListener; vraag lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Rapporteer translation.x en .y met report_transform.
hints: Vang TransformException op zolang er nog geen transformatie is.
Tel niet zomaar 0.2 op bij de wereld-x: de offset draait mee.
De buffer combineert de verbindingen; alleen de nieuwste vlakke transformaties worden ondersteund.

fr.title: Dans quel repère ?
fr.description: Le laser est placé 0.2 m devant base_link. Trouvez son origine dans odom, même lorsque le robot tourne.
steps: Inspectez /tf et l’arbre TF.
Créez Buffer et TransformListener ; demandez lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Rapportez translation.x et .y avec report_transform.
hints: Interceptez TransformException avant la première transformation.
N’ajoutez pas simplement 0.2 à x : le décalage tourne avec le robot.
Le buffer compose les liens ; seules les dernières transformations planes sont prises en charge.

es.title: ¿En qué marco?
es.description: El láser está 0.2 m delante de base_link. Calcula su origen en odom, también con el robot girado.
steps: Inspecciona ros2 topic echo /tf --once y la cadena odom → base_link → laser_link.
Crea Buffer y TransformListener. Consulta lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()) desde un temporizador.
Informa de translation.x y translation.y con report_transform. target_frame indica dónde expresar el resultado.
hints: Espera las transformaciones: captura TransformException al principio.
No sumes 0.2 directamente a x en odom; el desplazamiento gira con el robot.
El buffer compone los dos enlaces. Aquí solo hay transformaciones planas actuales.

de.title: Welches Koordinatensystem?
de.description: Der Laser sitzt 0.2 m vor base_link. Bestimme seinen Ursprung in odom, auch bei gedrehtem Roboter.
steps: Untersuche ros2 topic echo /tf --once und odom → base_link → laser_link.
Erstelle Buffer und TransformListener. Frage im Timer lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()) ab.
Melde translation.x und translation.y mit report_transform. target_frame gibt das Bezugskoordinatensystem an.
hints: Warte auf Transformationen: Fange anfangs TransformException ab.
Addiere nicht einfach 0.2 zu odom-x; der Sensorversatz dreht sich mit.
Der Buffer verknüpft beide Kanten. Hier sind nur aktuelle ebene Transformationen verfügbar.

pt.title: Qual é o referencial?
pt.description: O laser fica 0.2 m à frente de base_link. Calcula a sua origem em odom, incluindo com o robô rodado.
steps: Inspeciona ros2 topic echo /tf --once e a cadeia odom → base_link → laser_link.
Cria Buffer e TransformListener. Consulta lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()) num temporizador.
Comunica translation.x e translation.y com report_transform. target_frame indica onde expressar o resultado.
hints: Espera pelas transformações: captura TransformException nos primeiros callbacks.
Não somes simplesmente 0.2 a x em odom; o deslocamento roda com o robô.
O buffer compõe os dois elos. Aqui só existem transformações planas atuais.

it.title: Quale sistema di riferimento?
it.description: Il laser è montato 0,2 m davanti a base_link. Trova la sua origine in odom, anche quando il robot è ruotato.
steps: Ispeziona ros2 topic echo /tf --once. L’albero è odom → base_link → laser_link.
Crea Buffer e TransformListener. Nel timer richiedi lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Riporta translation.x e translation.y con report_transform. Il target_frame è il riferimento in cui vuoi esprimere la risposta.
hints: Attendi le trasformazioni: gestisci TransformException nei primi callback.
Non basta aggiungere 0.2 a odom x: anche l’offset del sensore ruota con il robot.
Il buffer compone entrambi gli archi. Qui supporta solo l’ultima trasformazione planare, non query storiche.

content.description: The laser is mounted 0.2 m ahead of base_link. Find its origin in odom, including when the robot is rotated.
steps: Inspect ros2 topic echo /tf --once. The tree is odom → base_link → laser_link.
